title: Signature Pill Story Card
concept: Every discharge medicine comes with a story card — what it does, told as a tiny tale with pictures, in the patient's language. 'This one keeps your blood slippery so clots can't form.' Understanding in narrative form. Concept by Manon.
improvement_over_conventional: Improves on tiny-print labels with memorable medication stories.
patient_flow: Orders flow electronically to pharmacy verification — dose, interactions, allergies, kidney function checked. Technicians prepare and dispense; pharmacists compound sterile products. Clinical pharmacists round on units, adjust dosing, and counsel high-risk discharges. Every step is bar-coded and double-checked.
code_demo:
# Signature Pill Story Card — Signature design prototype
def renal_dose_adjust(creatinine, age, weight_kg, female, normal_dose_mg):
    """Cockcroft-Gault creatinine clearance -> dose band suggestion."""
    scr = max(creatinine, 0.6)
    crcl = ((140 - age) * weight_kg) / (72 * scr)
    if female: crcl *= 0.85
    factor = 1.0 if crcl >= 60 else 0.75 if crcl >= 30 else 0.5
    return f"CrCl ~{crcl:.0f} mL/min -> give {round(normal_dose_mg*factor)} mg (verify with pharmacist)"
print(renal_dose_adjust(1.6, 72, 70, False, 1000))
teaching: Simple: the core idea in plain words — what it is and why it matters.
